learning_objective: 🎯 Learn how to kick the ball with awesome power, control your passes, and receive the ball smoothly like a champion football player!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Use the side of your foot or your shoelaces to kick the ball firmly. Never use your toes, or the ball will fly in the wrong direction!
When the ball rolls towards you, relax your foot and pull it back slightly as the ball hits it. This cushions the ball so it stays right under your control.
Keep the ball super close to your feet while running. Use light, quick taps with the inside and outside of your shoes to move past defenders!

fun_activity.title: ⚽ The Wall Pass Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Stand a few steps away from a blank wall. Kick the ball against the wall and try to receive it smoothly with your foot when it bounces back. See how many you can do without losing control!

quick_recap: ⭐ Always lock your ankle and use the side of your foot for a perfectly straight pass.
⭐ Act like your foot is a soft pillow when receiving a fast ball to stop it neatly.
⭐ Look up while dribbling so you can spot your teammates and the goal!
